findings: BLOCKER - PH-276's frozen reversal/pairing DoR is not executable on the PH-269 schema it claims to reuse without a migration: PH-276 says it reuses `BillableConfirmationReceipt` with `action=reverse` and keeps the time leaf at PH-269's 0001 with no new migration, but PH-269's receipt CheckConstraint only allows action in ('draft.save','confirm'), and PH-269's PostgreSQL/SQLite update guards only permit draft->confirmed (OLD.status must be draft; NEW.status NOT IN ('draft','confirmed') is rejected). A confirmed->reversed status transition and a reverse receipt are therefore impossible under the existing trigger/constraint; PH-276 would fail before any pairing work. Fix this planning slot by either (a) adding a PH-276-owned time migration (e.g. time/0002) that extends the receipt action enum and the confirmation state transition to confirmed->reversed, with SQLite/PostgreSQL guards and the migration path added to PH-276's exact whitelist, or (b) narrowing/removing the reversal scope and stating the required migration/trigger change explicitly; keep PH-276 proposed on PH-269 until then. The current 'no new migration / reuse existing receipt' contract is not deliverable.
